description: Explicit RFC-0165 source/profile contracts. The production freeze fails closed until every discovered source and normal/opt/native profile has a reviewed contract.

contract_fields.classification: known-valid, intentionally-invalid, or external-fixture; never inferred from a path or exit status.
contract_fields.freeze_class: v1-direct, v1-materialized, v2-required, or null; explicit for every source/profile.
contract_fields.check_expectation: admitted, rejected, or either; records the contract for the observed check result.
contract_fields.execution: check-only or check-then-run; only the latter permits the post-check production CLI step.
contract_fields.normalization: optional explicit stdout/stderr byte-regex replacements; absent means no normalization.
